lines.text: Jeremiah speaks a word of tears, seeing those slain by the sword in the country and famine in the city.
The people confess their sin, ask the LORD to remember His covenant, and put their hope in Him for rain.
The LORD says that even if Moses and Elijah stood before Him, He would not pity this people.
The LORD appoints four kinds of destroyers and makes them a horror because of what Ahaz son of Hezekiah did.
Jerusalem forsook Him, so the LORD will destroy her, multiply widows like sand, and put the rest to the sword.
